notes: Dire Maul's central courtyard (recheck2): the lattice cannot route it. Eldreth Row's floor (WMO 7952258's piece 0) runs from the outer ramp by the moonwell (126) up to the hall (161) and down its north ramp onto the courtyard's terrain ring, but the ramp is one quad whose foot vertices lie 1.7-2.1 yd under the terrain (MOUTH_YD 1.5: no mouth, no cave way), and a lattice route there drops 79 yd off the west rampart (a floor at 230-235 levels the column under it). So the courtyard is walked as route C (Camp Mojache -> the moonwell) + the floorCity route K on the WMO's own floor. floorCity takes 7952258 off the caves list (its ways are walked as the floor instead).
